Here are reliable places you can buy **makeup online in Saudi Arabia** (deliver within KSA):

## Beauty retailers (wide makeup selection)
- **Sephora Middle East (KSA site)** – prestige brands + frequent “online only” items. ([sephora.me](https://www.sephora.me/sa-en?utm_source=openai))  
- **Nice One (نايس ون)** – popular Saudi beauty app/store with a big cosmetics selection. ([play.google.com](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=com.NiceOne.App&utm_source=openai))  
- **Golden Scent** – strong for fragrance and also carries beauty; delivers within KSA (shipping details on their FAQ). ([faq.goldenscent.com](https://faq.goldenscent.com/en/faqs/delivery.html?utm_source=openai))  

## Fashion/beauty platforms that also sell makeup
- **Namshi (KSA)** – has a dedicated **Makeup** category with many well-known brands. ([namshi.com](https://www.namshi.com/saudi-en/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Ounass (Saudi site)** – more luxury-leaning beauty/makeup; ships within GCC incl. Saudi. ([en-saudi.ounass.com](https://en-saudi.ounass.com/women/beauty/make-up?utm_source=openai))  

## Pharmacy/marketplaces (good for drugstore + deals, but check the seller)
- **Nahdi (online/app)** – pharmacy chain with an app and online shopping (often good for drugstore makeup/skincare). ([play.google.com](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=ar&id=com.nahdi.main&utm_source=openai))  
- **Noon (KSA)** – very large selection and fast delivery options (Noon Minutes in some areas), but it’s a marketplace, so seller-checking matters. ([noon.com](https://www.noon.com/saudi-en/beauty/makeup-16142/?utm_source=openai))  

### Quick safety tip (especially on marketplaces like Noon/Amazon-style listings)
Prefer items **sold by the brand or the platform itself**, and avoid listings with unclear/unknown sellers if you’re trying to minimize counterfeit risk.

If you tell me your **city (e.g., Riyadh/Jeddah/Dammam)** and whether you want **luxury** (Dior/Armani) or **drugstore** (Maybelline/Essence), I can narrow this to the best 3 options for delivery speed + pricing.
